title: react-toasties
description: A lightweight, customizable toast notification library for React. Zero dependencies, fully accessible, and developer-friendly.
longDescription: Built and published an NPM package that brings elegant, accessible toast notifications to any React project. Features customizable duration, positioning, types (success/error/info/warning), and a minimal API surface. Downloaded by developers worldwide.

title: react-comboboxes
description: Accessible, composable combobox components for React — built with WAI-ARIA patterns and zero runtime dependencies.
longDescription: A published NPM package providing headless combobox/autocomplete components following WAI-ARIA design patterns. Fully composable, keyboard navigable, and designed for real-world form use cases. Works seamlessly with any design system.

title: rag-beginner-guide
description: This repository is a hands-on, beginner-friendly guide to building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system from scratch using Python. No theory overload. No black-box magic. Just real code, real debugging, and real GenAI engineering.
longDescription: A production-grade Airbnb replica built with React and Firebase. Features property search with geo-filters, user authentication, booking management, and a responsive mobile-first UI. Demonstrates real-world CRUD patterns and state management.

title: webpush-notifications
description: This repository contains a proof of concept (POC) for implementing browser popup notifications using Web Push
longDescription: Full-featured Instagram replica with React and Firebase Realtime Database. Supports image uploads, real-time feed updates, user authentication, and infinite scroll. Styled to match Instagram's design language.

title: custom-react-hooks
description: This repository contains some of the most useful custom react hooks that will enhance your overall react development period by reducing your time consumption. These hooks will definitly help make your project easier.
longDescription: A Signal-inspired messaging application built with React Native and Firebase. Features real-time messaging via Firestore, group chats, push notifications, and a clean privacy-first UI. Works across iOS and Android.

title: Uber Clone
description: A ride-hailing app clone with real-time maps, driver tracking, fare calculation, and booking flows.
longDescription: A React Native Uber clone powered by Google Maps API and Firebase. Features real-time driver location tracking, route calculation, fare estimation, and multi-step booking UI. Demonstrates complex map interactions and state management in mobile apps.
